Banana Dog
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Saturday, May 7, 2011 - 4:55pm

Ingredients




1 hot dog roll
2 tablespoons peanut butter
1 firm banana
Honey or maple syrup

Preparation

1 Lightly toast the hot dog roll on bagel cycle, so the inside is lightly browned, but the outside remains soft 2 Spread peanut butter on both sides of the toasted bun 3 Peel a banana and lay it in the bun 4 Drizzle honey or maple syrup over the hot dog and serve

About


Great for a Mother's day breakfast that the kids can make
